3801961.name: Explorer's Pack
3801961.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by 4% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 30. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nIf you're crazy enough to descend into Azmoth Chasm, you'll need the right gear! This pack may not help you in combat, but mark my words, you'll be glad to have it in the end.

3801962.name: Advanced Explorer's Pack
3801962.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by 6% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 50. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThis pack may weigh you down a bit, but it's full of gear to help you through the perils of Azmoth Chasm. You'll face more than monsters, after all.

3801963.name: Veteran Explorer's Pack
3801963.desc: #cReduces Final Damage by 8% and increases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 100. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThe only way we'll ever truly understand the fate of Azmoth is to examine every inch of the chasm with specialized gear... Just make sure you're ready for some rough fights, all right?

3801964.name: Vile Lash
3801964.desc: #cIncreases points earned after stopping the Azmothian Guardians within 60 seconds by 50.#\nOn the day of Azmoth's ruin, more than one of its nobles learned that pain and fear can only stay a vengeful hand for so long...

3801965.name: Vicious Lash
3801965.desc: #cIncreases points earned upon stopping the Azmothian Guardians within 60 seconds by 100.#\nThe ruin of Azmoth was not justice. How could it be, when weighed against the torment Azmoth wrought, the blood the city spilled? Stand in this grave of uncounted dreams and realize that what some would call justice was merely a relief.

3801966.name: Drak's Research Notes
3801966.desc: A #cresearch record# written in some lost language. Based on the images and the maddened scrawl, whoever wrote this did something unspeakable.

3801967.name: Alchemist Stone
3801967.desc: #cChanges into an Awakened Stone after advancing 4 times in a row.#\nCreated by an alchemist of Azmoth, it could easily pass for a normal stone.

3801968.name: Black Alchemist Stone
3801968.desc: #cChanges into an Awakened Black Stone after advancing 4 times in a row#\nCreated by an alchemist of Azmoth, it could easily pass for a normal stone.

3801969.name: Awakened Stone
3801969.desc: #cIncreases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 90.#\nUnable to trust each other with their most prized secrets, the alchemists of Azmoth created advisors of a more unnatural source. As you stare into the weeping eyes of this stone, it whispers its dark counsel in the back of your mind.

3801970.name: Awakened Black Stone
3801970.desc: #cIncreases points earned after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians by 220.#\nThe alchemists of Azmoth hoarded knowledge from each other, only trusting their secrets to living stones, servants supposedly bound to the will of their creator. But as you see this stone open its eyes and hear its whispered words of temptation, you wonder at the wisdom of their choice.

3801971.name: Grave Robber's Backpack
3801971.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 3% for each held item owned. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nMore than one grave robber has braved the depths of Azmoth Chasm looking for treasure... Seeing as the former owner of this pack is nowhere to be seen, you have a good idea of what happened to them.

3801972.name: Grave Robber's Bulging Backpack
3801972.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 4% for each held item owned. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nMore than one grave robber has braved the depths of Azmoth Chasm looking for treasure... Seeing as the former owner of this large pack is nowhere to be seen, you have a good idea of what happened to them.

3801973.name: Whispering Tome
3801973.desc: #cIncreases stamina reduction by 5 and Final Damage by 4% upon entering Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nAs you pick up the Whispering Tome, your mind runs cold and your breath dies in your throat. You can almost hear its sibilant song of the sorcerers of Azmoth... and the great terror they worked in their dark towers.

3801974.name: Tome of the High Sybarite
3801974.desc: #cIncreases stamina reduction by 5 and Final Damage by 9% upon entering Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nA tome warm with a sickening heat, as if it were a living thing. As you take it in your hands, you can see the glories of lost Azmoth, its rioting gardens and unfathomable sorceries... and the blood soaked into its stones. Look at the ruin around you, hero. And remember that all greed has its price.

3801975.name: Gladiator's Amulet
3801975.desc: #cIncreases damage taken by 10% and Final Damage by 3% after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe nobles of Azmoth once thought to mock their gladiators with amulets of purest silver, little realizing that by forcing their captives to fight and die in the coliseum, they were forging a blade that would turn against them on the day ruin came.

3801976.name: Battle-Hammered Gladiator's Amulet
3801976.desc: #cIncreases damage taken by 15% and Final Damage by 7% after successfully completing Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the cumulative effect of all chasm items.#\nThe berserkers were the most unfortunate captives in Azmoth's coliseum, gladiators driven mad by foul poisons and fouler sorceries. But they never fought with more ferocity than on the day Azmoth crumbled, when their battle fury was fueled not by hate and torment, but hope.

3801977.name: Emergency Protection Spell
3801977.desc: #cSeals chasm item effects, defends against stamina decreases based on time remaining, and recovers an additional 35 stamina when a stage ends 2 times.#\nA scroll of protective magic, fashioned by an ancient wizard to protect his pupils. It will preserve you from the horrors of Azmoth for a time, but it will also seal away any beneficial effects from cursed objects.\n...For some reason, the scroll is covered in cat hair.

3801978.name: Demon Rag Doll
3801978.desc: A rag doll of a #cdemon child#, complete with wings and horns. It was sewn with deepest love, and once comforted a young girl through many nights of bitter tears.

3801979.name: Barbed Arrowheads
3801979.desc: A handful of ancient arrowheads, still gleaming with a lethal #clight# though the rest of the arrow has long since rotted way. A cruel hand fashioned them to inflict the maximum amount of pain.

3801980.name: Dusty Blood Vial
3801980.desc: The glass of this vial is fogged with dirt, but the dark red color of the liquid sloshing around inside is unmistakable. It is full of #cblood#, which looks as fresh as the day it was drawn.

3801981.name: Wanted Poster Stack
3801981.desc: A sheaf of crumbling wanted posters, yellow with age. In place of criminals, each dusty page depicts a different fugitive demon who made a #cpowerful enemy#.

3801982.name: Arcane Defense Manual
3801982.desc: A ponderous tome detailing the schematics for the #carcane turrets# of Azmoth. Buried deep in its labyrinthine pages is the knowledge of the turrets' power source, an arcane fuel derived from a resource the rulers of Azmoth had in plentiful supply: demon blood.

3801983.name: Bloody Alchemy Tools
3801983.desc: You don't know what kind of #calchemy experiment# requires a sawtooth blade, bandages, and a bottle of preservative solution... but you hope you never find out.

3801984.name: Heretical Icon
3801984.desc: A diamond icon of heretical faith, with a #clidless eye# at its heart. In the flickering light, the pupil almost seems to be following your movements...

3801985.name: Gnawed Femur
3801985.desc: A #cmassive femur# from a creature unknown, now covered in tooth marks. A doctor might say it that looks more like a finger bone than a femur, but what monster could have a hand that big?

3801986.name: Emergency Rations
3801986.desc: Emergency rations cached by the advance exploration team. It doesn't look like anything has broken the seal, so they #cshould# be safe to eat.

3801987.name: Drak's Torn Notes
3801987.desc: A #ctorn page#, covered in an indescribable script. No one in their right mind would want to decipher what it says.

3801988.name: Homemade Hairpin
3801988.desc: A #chomemade hairpin#, created in hopes of bringing some small comfort to a distraught child. Examining the pin closely, you realize that it would be the perfect tool for picking the lock on a pair of manacles.

3801989.name: Strange Dagger
3801989.desc: A #cperfectly ordinary dagger#, well-used but well-maintained. Its handle is bare of device and it is identical to a thousand other blades you've seen in your adventures... so why does holding it make your heart run cold?

3801990.name: Vial of Viscous Blood
3801990.desc: At first, the dark red liquid inside this vial appears solid, with immobile bubbles pressed up against the glass. But as hours pass, the bubbles slowly rise and you realize the liquid is boiling in slow motion. Just what kind of #cblood# is inside?

3801991.name: Portrait of a Would-be God
3801991.desc: A dirty, once luxurious portrait of a #chorned demon#, gazing out towards the viewer with a haughty expression. His eyes shine with ambition and there's a self-indulgent twist to his smile. The golden label on the frame bears the name #cDrak#.

3801992.name: Drak's Ritual Scroll
3801992.desc: #cPlans written in an indescribable script#. The few illustrations you can decipher seem to detail gold, artifacts, and an ocean of blood...

3801993.name: Demonic Idol
3801993.desc: A small idol of a horned and winged demon carved out of dark stone. For some reason, you feel your arm curling into a #cthrowing motion# as you hold it.

3801994.name: Golem Self-Destruct Scroll
3801994.desc: Every alchemist in Azmoth carried a copy of this scroll at their hip, no matter where they were. They knew it was their last defense against a #cgolem# gone rogue.

3801995.name: The Encyclopedia of Infernus Husbandry
3801995.desc: A thick compendium perfect for any delusional soul hoping to rear an #cInfernus# of their very own. The illustrations of the proper feeding methods would give you nightmares if they weren't so cute.

3801996.name: Demon Mercenary Badge
3801996.desc: Handheld proof of the owner's membership in a #cmercenary company#. You have no idea why the sellsword band came to the cursed land of Azmoth, but it's clear that despite their preparations none returned alive.

3801997.name: Ruinous Ritual Blade
3801997.desc: The curse seeping from this #cmysterious ritualistic blade# is so incredibly vile, it might just be the source of the ruin that befell Azmoth Chasm.

3801998.name: Azmothian Ore
3801998.desc: #cSummons 1 Goldeater after successfully completing a Vanguard Defense or Azmothian Guardians and increases points earned by slaying Goldeaters by 300.#\nAs Azmoth's doom approached, the paranoid rulers of the city descended into fratricidal strife. To protect themselves from their so-called allies, they created a mysterious ore that marked their fiercest enemies with a golden glow.

3801999.name: Burning Azmothian Ore
3801999.desc: #cSummons 2 Goldeaters after successfully completing a Vanguard Defense or Azmothian Guardians and increases points earned by slaying Goldeaters by 300.#\nTell me... what good is a metal that marks your deadliest foes gold when every friend comes wearing a knife-edged smile and every servant stokes fire in their heart?

3802000.name: Sorcerer's Veil
3802000.desc: #c50% stamina reduction 1 time when rechallenging after failing to progress.#\nThis veil is comfortable, almost refreshing, on your face, but its origins with a dark sect of sorcerers undeniably pulls at your mind at times.

3802001.name: Silken Sorcerer's Veil
3802001.desc: #c100% stamina reduction 1 time when rechallenging after a failing to progress.#\nNothing quite feels as good as this silken covering on your face...and that thought threatens to lead your mind down darker paths.

3802002.name: Grim Epaulette
3802002.desc: #cIncreases the chances of finding a higher-ranked item when you get the next item.#\nDrak's personal guards were marked with these epaulettes, signaling their viciousness and cruelty to those they made demands of.

3802003.name: Threatening Epaulette
3802003.desc: #cIncreases the chances of finding a higher-ranked item when you get the next item.#\nDrak's most trusted guards wore these epaulettes, indicating that their every demand must be acknowledged, on pain of death.

3802004.name: Guardbreaker Pendant
3802004.desc:
#cLowers the difficulty for the next Azmothian Guardians.
- Aidan: Increases Final Damage up to 5% based on Glorious Memory.
- Kind Azrael: Increases Essence Destroyed duration by 2 sec.
- Infernus Harbinger: Defends against Hellfire Curse for 15 sec.#
This pendant bears a power that can repel Azmoth's guardians, but it does not appear to have done its long-departed owner much good.

3802005.name: Unproven Demonic Inoculant
3802005.desc: #cRestores 40 stamina.#\nMagatia's alchemists hastily concocted this serum to counteract demonic influences, but it lacked essential potency.

3802006.name: Demonic Inoculant
3802006.desc: #cRestores 60 stamina.#\nAfter some urgent reformulation, Magatia's alchemists were able to produce this effective serum.

3802007.name: Special Demonic Inoculant
3802007.desc: #cRestores 80 stamina.#\nThis potent serum was the result of tireless, sometimes desperate refinement from Magatia's alchemists.

3802008.name: Strawberry-Scented Syrup
3802008.desc: #cPrevent HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once.#\nA simple sweetener gifted from father to daughter can be all the motivation one needs to push past their limits.

3802009.name: Father's Keepsake
3802009.desc: #cPrevents HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once, and increases Final Damage by 10%. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nA beloved father concocted this powerful potion with the best of intentions, but tragically never saw it used.

3802010.name: Artifact Case
3802010.desc: #cGrants a chance to get an epic chasm item.#\nLayered with years of dust and marked with desperate gashes, this unassuming box could hold a most precious treasure.

3802011.name: Artifact Reliquary
3802011.desc: #cGrants a chance to get a unique chasm item.#\nBattered and grimy, one would never expect this box to be so hotly pursued for the rumored relic within.

3802012.name: Azmothian Crystal
3802012.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 15% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThis ephemeral crystal constantly emits steam and light, lending its strength to those around it.

3802013.name: Azmothian Blood Crystal
3802013.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 20% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nWreathed in steam and crimson light, this crystal fills your soul with newfound power.

3802014.name: Hunter's Talisman
3802014.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 500 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nDemon hunters take any advantage they can get, and this grim keepsake is said to bring them good fortune.

3802015.name: Horrifying Talisman
3802015.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nNo one would think these vicious claws could bring good luck, but demon hunters are cut from a very different cloth.

3802016.name: Fanzy's Energy Tonic
3802016.desc: #cRestores 60 stamina.#\nThe mind is your most precious resource in Azmoth, a fact that led Fanzy to create this mentally-reinforcing draught

3802017.name: Fanzy's Special Tonic
3802017.desc: #cRestores 80 stamina.#\nFanzy's experiences in the chasm may have given him nightmares, but they also allowed him to perfect the formula for his tincture, providing a powerful reinforcement against the withering horrors of Azmoth.

3802018.name: 10 Boogies's Evidence Sack
3802018.desc: #cGrants a chance to get an epic chasm item.#\n10 Boogies has been gathering up all kinds of suspicious items to report on. Surely there must be something worthwhile here...

3802019.name: 10 Boogies's Special Evidence Sack
3802019.desc: #cGrants a chance to get a unique chasm item.#\n10 Boogies set this particular sack of questionable items aside, which suggests there may be especially good stuff inside.

3802020.name: Azmothian Alchemy Crystal
3802020.desc: #cRestores 60 stamina.#\nSomething must have shocked this red crystal into forming, given its strange shape. The vital energies radiating from it are definitely stranger still.

3802021.name: Forbidden Alchemy Crystal
3802021.desc: #cRestores 80 stamina.#\nThe life energy seeping from this crystal is powerful enough to seriously question how such a thing could be made...and what the cost of that process could have been.

3802022.name: Coliseum Booster
3802022.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 15% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nThe blue crystal inside this bottle vaporizes when exposed to air, and whatever power it contains transfers to those around it.

3802023.name: Red Coliseum Booster
3802023.desc: #cIncreases Final Damage by 20% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians. Final Damage is applied based on the total effect of all chasm items.#\nWhatever this red crystal is, it fills you with seemingly unholy strength once unbottled.

3802024.name: Azrael's Note
3802024.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 500 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nAzrael collected his thoughts about Azmoth's structure here, which could be quite valuable to the expedition.

3802025.name: Azrael's Journal
3802025.desc: #cIncreases points earned by 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.#\nWith more experiences to draw on, Azrael outlined nearly the full scope of Azmoth in this extensive journal. The information within is absolutely invaluable.

3802026.name: Azmothian Silver Coin
3802026.desc: A #ccoin# featuring a portrait of a horned individual. Who knows how valuable this could be?

3802027.name: Azmothian Gold Coin
3802027.desc: A #ccoin# featuring a portrait of a horned individual. Who knows how valuable this could be?

3802028.name: Magatia's Support
3802028.desc:
The alchemists of Magatia have spared no expense to support the exploration of Azmoth Chasm. You may not know exactly what this experimental potion will do... but you're pretty sure it'll be beneficial.
#cGrants a chance to get one of the following effects:
- Prevents HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once.
- Prevents HP from reaching 0 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians once, and increases Final Damage by 10%.
- Grants a chance to get an epic chasm item.
- Grants a chance to get a unique chasm item.
- Increases Final Damage by 15% or 20% during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.
- Increases points earned by 500 or 600 during the next Vanguard Defense and Azmothian Guardians.
- Recovers 50 or 60 Resistance.#

3802046.name: Broken Gingerbread Man
3802046.desc: A broken gingerbread men, doing his best to hold it all together.\r\nAn ornament for the #cDark Maplemas Tree#.

3994089.desc: A memory chip Agent W left with me.  Information regarding 'Master M' is said to be contained in it.  If I don't enter the secret code every hour, it will self-destruct.

3994115.name: Easy Mode
3994115.desc: Entrance Level: Lv. 30 or above\nRecommended Level: Lv. 30 - Lv. 49

3994116.name: Normal Mode
3994116.desc: Entrance Level: Lv. 50 or above\nRecommended Level: Lv. 50 - Lv. 69

3994120.name: Unknown
3994120.desc: An unknown being that has yet to be explained.

3994138.name: Ice Crystal
3994138.desc: A solid ice crystal that contains Maha Charm. Hold onto it for one hour and the crystal will melt, enabling you to acquire the Charm.

3994139.name: Maha Charm
3994139.desc: A charm that contains protection from Maha, the spirit of Polearm. Take this to Cassandra for a chance to answer questions and receive prizes.

3994179.name: Cassandra's Star Box
3994179.desc: Box with Cassandra's PC Cafe Giant Star. Stay online with this for 90 minutes to transform it into Cassandra's PC Cafe Giant Star. Disappears when you log out.

3994180.name: Cassandra's PC Cafe Giant Star
3994180.desc: PC Cafe Giant Star that Cassandra is looking for. Disappears when you log out.

3994184.name: Cassandra's Strange Potion
3994184.desc: Hold onto this for 30 minutes and the cold weather will turn it into slush. It's so delicate it will disappear if you log out.

3994185.name: Cassandra's Strange Slush
3994185.desc: Give it to Cassandra before it disappears!

3994186.name: Mini Dragon Egg
3994186.desc: A Mini Dragon Egg that Cassandra has left in your care. You must hold it close and keep it warm for one hour for it to hatch. Logging out will cause it to be destroyed.

3994187.name: Mini Dragon
3994187.desc: A Mini Dragon that hatched from the egg Cassandra left with you. Return it to Cassandra to receive a reward!

3994188.name: Empty Compass
3994188.desc: An empty compass that will eventually be used to make a Golden Compass.

3994192.name: Dark Feather
3994192.desc: A black feather from a bird that has not been identified. Keep an eye on it for 15 minutes and it will transform into a Bright Feather.\n#cIt will disappear once you log out.#

3994193.name: Bright Feather
3994193.desc: A bright feather from a bird that has not been identified. Take it over to the Maple Admin.

3994195.name: 6 King Star
3994195.desc: A large star specially made to commemorate MapleStory's 6th anniversary. Carry it with you for 45 minutes to receive a Star Stamp.

3994196.name: Hawkeye Sticker
3994196.desc: A Hawkeye sticker. Collect all 5 Cygnus Knights stickers to receive a limited reward.

3994197.name: Carta's Sandglass
3994197.desc: It takes 2 hours for the sand in Carta's Sandglass to trickle down to the bottom.

3994198.name: Carta's Sandglass
3994198.desc: The sand in Carta's Sandglass has trickled down to the bottom.

3994209.name: Oz Sticker
3994209.desc: An Oz sticker. Collect all 5 Cygnus Knights stickers to receive a limited reward.

3994220.name: Thanksgiving Han Gwa
3994220.desc: Tasty Han Gwa made of baked rice crackers and syrup. Take this to the Maple Administrator.

3994241.name: Cassandra's Hot Stone
3994241.desc: The hot Stone that Cassandra requested. It absorbs the carrier's body heat and gets warmer and warmer. Carry it with you for a set time to receive a Star Stamp.

3994246.name: Yellow Four-leaf Clover
3994246.desc: A little four-leaf clover that sparkles with yellow. It will turn into green four-leaf clover in time.

3994247.name: Green Four-leaf Clover
3994247.desc: A fresh green four-leaf clover. They say four-leaf clovers are lucky.

3994248.name: Deep Blue Baggy Jeans
3994248.desc: A fabulous combination of a white hoodie and popular baggy jeans.

3994249.name: Sweet Pink Angel Wings
3994249.desc: Beautiful wings to go along with your blue jeans.

3994253.desc: A highly-desired combination of white and blue.

3994255.name: Yellow Anticipation

3994352.desc: Pour this light, sweet liquid over your Special Sundae, and then prepare yourself for a sugary taste explosion!

3994359.desc: A shiny charm from Gaga. When held by a Cannoneer, the area surrounding their monkey will glow.
3994359.desc_leftalign: Double-click the icon to toggle ON/OFF.

3994360.name: Monkey Doll
3994360.desc: A monkey doll that Gaga lost. Collect 30 and bring them to Gaga.

3994361.name: Red Bling Bling Monkey
3994361.desc: A shiny charm. When held by a Cannoneer, the area surrounding their monkey will glow.
3994361.desc_leftalign: Double-click the icon to toggle ON/OFF.

3994362.name: Maple 3000 Days Commemorative Stamp
3994362.desc: This is a 3000 Days Commemorative Stamp to celebrate Maple's 3000-day anniversary. Collect 3000 to obtain a 3000-Day Medal.

3994363.name: Red Strawberry
3994363.desc: Juicy red strawberries for making Strawberry Juice.

3994364.name: Cool Melon
3994364.desc: A sweet melon for making Melon Juice.

3994365.name: Ripe Kiwi
3994365.desc: A tasty kiwi for making Kiwi Juice.

3994366.name: Fresh Pineapple
3994366.desc: A plump pineapple for making Pineapple Juice.

3994367.name: Maple Syrup
3994367.desc: Syrup for sweetening fruit juice. Keep it for 30 minutes, and it may develop a legendary taste...

3994368.name: Legendary Maple Syrup
3994368.desc: A fully matured maple syrup, featuring a bold, complex flavor unlike any other.

3994369.name: Legendary Lamp
3994369.desc: A lamp spoken of in legends past. Keep the light on for 50 minutes to receive a Legends Coin.

3994372.name: Cosmic Green
3994372.desc: A star stone that contains energy from all the green stars in space. Place it in your Set-up window and fill up your gauge to activate the Going Green skill.

3994373.name: Good Vibe Detector
3994373.desc: A device that measures the amount of Good Vibe in Maple World. Keep it in your Set-up window for 30 minutes to complete the measurement.

3994374.name: Completed Good Vibe Detector
3994374.desc: A Good Vibe Detector that has completed its measurement. The blinking light means it's done.

3994376.name: Nutritious Drumstick
3994376.desc: A well-cooked chicken drumstick. It is both tasty and nutritious.

3994377.name: Nutritious Drumstick
3994377.desc: A well-cooked chicken drumstick. It is both tasty and nutritious.

3994378.name: Command Emblem
3994378.desc: An emblem worn by the commanders under the Black Mage. Their origin and full meaning are unknown.

3994379.name: Mini-Coconut Tree
3994379.desc: A symbol of Waikiki. Just looking at it makes you dream of the beach.

3994380.name: Melted Igloo
3994380.desc: An igloo, partially melted by the sun. Hold it for 30 minutes without logging out, and it may return to its legendary form...

3994381.name: Legendary Igloo
3994381.desc: The legendary igloo. Gaze at it, and feel the howling winds of Alaska!

3994382.name: Noise Recorder
3994382.desc: A recorder that can be used to record nearby noises. It can record for 30 minutes.

3994383.name: Completed Noise Recorder
3994383.desc: A completed recorder that has reached its 30-minute capacity. The recorded noise can be used to make sounds that monsters hate.

3994384.name: Roasted Turkey
3994384.desc: A yummy roasted turkey you remember enjoying during Thanksgiving.

3994385.name: Golden Maple Leaf
3994385.desc: A Maple Leaf that pulsates with a golden aura.

3994388.name: Good Looking Monkey Doll
3994388.desc: A good looking monkey doll. If you look closely, you might think that this monkey looks like a celebrity.

3994389.name: Maple Legends Commemorative Stamp
3994389.desc: A commemorative stamp that was made with the support of many Maplers.

3994390.name: Cosmic Green
3994390.desc: A crystal of stars that only have filled with the memory of blue stars that exist in the outer space.

3994391.name: Piece of Trash
3994391.desc: A dirty piece of trash. You should pick it up to keep this Maple World a cleaner place! Just wash your hands afterwards.

3994392.name: Totally Cool Melon
3994392.desc: A Totally Cool Melon that can be a material to make a tasty Melon juice.

3994393.name: Wet Fireworks
3994393.desc: You put the rain-soaked Fireworks in the Magic Powder. Now they will dry out in about 30 minutes.

3994394.name: Nice Dry Fireworks
3994394.desc: Thanks to the Magic Powder, these Fireworks are completely dry and ready to use! Take these to Gaga.

3994395.name: Faded Photograph
3994395.desc: An old and faded photograph of someone.

3994396.name: Old Hankerchief
3994396.desc: An old and worn out hankerchief. You can't even tell its original color.

3994398.name: Love Detector
3994398.desc: A bizarre device that might lead you to Cassandra's first love. Have this in your Set-up window for 30 minutes to get results.

3994399.name: Complete Love Detector
3994399.desc: A Love Detector that has turned something up. Take this to Gaga and show him the results.

3994400.name: Wish Paper
3994400.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for a Golden Hammer 50%. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994401.name: Wish Paper
3994401.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for a Special Potential Scroll. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994402.name: Wish Paper
3994402.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for a Clean Slate Scroll 10%. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994403.name: Wish Paper
3994403.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for an Advanced Equip Enhancement Scroll. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994404.name: Wish Paper
3994404.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for an Armor Attack/Magic scroll. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994405.name: Wish Paper
3994405.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for a Weapon Scroll. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994406.name: Wish Paper
3994406.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for a Armor Stats Scroll. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994407.name: Wish Paper
3994407.desc: A Wish Paper to wish for a Mochi Ice Cream Chair. Collect 30 and deliver them to Moon Bunny by clicking on the Event Notifier at the left side of the screen. \n#Cannot be used for other wishes.#

3994408.name: White Song Pyun
3994408.desc: A Song Pyun made of Rice Flour.

3994409.name: Mugwort Song Pyun
3994409.desc: A Song Pyun made of Rice Flour and Mugworts Juice.

3994410.name: Pink Song Pyun
3994410.desc: A Song Pyun made of Rice Flour and Red Mango Syrup.

3994411.name: Golden Song Pyun
3994411.desc: A Song Pyun made of Rice Flour and Gardenia Extract.

3994412.name: Empty Moonlight Bottle
3994412.desc: An empty glass bottle that can hold moonlight. Hold it for 30 minutes and then close it.

3994413.name: Moonlight Bottle
3994413.desc: You closed the bottle after 30 minutes just like Gaga told you. Do you see moonlight in the bottle? Well, deliver it to Gaga anyway.

3994414.name: Rainbow Timer
3994414.desc: A timer Cassandra gave you. The display appears to be broken. Better keep it for 1 hour anyways.

3994415.name: Rainbow Timer
3994415.desc: A timer Cassandra gave you. It shows 60 min. 00 sec.

3994416.name: Wednesday Crayon Piece
3994416.desc: A broken piece of a crayon obtained from the Monster Park. You might be able to combine it more pieces to make a working crayon.

3994424.name: Crayon Piece
3994424.desc: A broken piece of a crayon obtained from a Party Quest. You might be able to combine it with more pieces to make a working crayon.

3994425.name: Saturday Crayon Piece
3994425.desc: A broken piece of a crayon obtained from monsters. You might be able to combine it with more pieces.

3994428.name: Strong Cage Key
3994428.desc: A key to open a cage where the little Miwok Boy is locked up. #cClick# on the cage with this key in your inventory.

3994429.name: Delicious Rice Roll
3994429.desc: A yummy rice roll made of many tasty ingredients.

3994430.name: Spicy Chicken Piece
3994430.desc: A delicious piece of chicken, smothered in a red spicy sauce.

3994431.name: Carbonated Drink
3994431.desc: A carbonated drink that refreshes completely. Experience the sparkling taste!

3994432.name: Spicy Rice Cake
3994432.desc: A fiery red rice cake. It's so spicy!

3994433.name: Sports Drink
3994433.desc: A sports drink that gets absorbed faster than water.

3994434.name: Frozen Sports Drink
3994434.desc: A frozen sports drink which gets absorbed way faster than water. It's so cold!

3994435.name: Miraculous Garlic
